name: POS
recent: Pos Malaysia 近期宣布以 1290 万美元出售一艘船舶，并推出 Pokémon 集邮系列，同时与 X Square Robot 探讨物流自动化合作。最新财报显示季度营收环比下降 4%，净亏损扩大至 4346 万令吉。
notable: 拟以 1290 万美元现金出售船舶 MV POS Logistics 1 给 WYW Co., Limited。
推出 Pokémon 集邮系列，包含自粘邮票和特别版商品。
与 X Square Robot 探讨 AI 驱动的物流自动化。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 4346 万令吉，亏损较上季扩大。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 4.813 亿令吉，环比下降 4%，同比增长 9%；净亏损 4346 万令吉，净利率 -9.0%，上季为 -3.9%。

recent_en: Pos Malaysia recently announced the disposal of a marine vessel for USD12.9 million, launched a Pokémon stamp collection, and is exploring logistics automation with X Square Robot. Its latest quarterly revenue fell 4% QoQ, with net loss widening to MYR43.46 million.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of marine vessel MV POS Logistics 1 to WYW Co., Limited for USD12.9 million cash.
Launched a Pokémon collectible series featuring self-adhesive stamps and special edition merchandise.
Exploring AI-driven logistics automation with X Square Robot.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss of MYR43.46 million, wider than the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR481.3 million, down 4% QoQ but up 9% YoY; net loss was MYR43.46 million with a net margin of -9.0% versus -3.9% in the prior quarter.
